game.name: DaytonaArm (Daytona USA)
game.desc: Native ARM64 / OpenGL ES 2.0 static recompilation runtime for Sega Model 2 Daytona USA (Deluxe '93 and Revision A 1994), tuned for Allwinner H700 / Anbernic RG34XX with 4-core pipelining and D-pad arcade spring steering. Bring your own MAME ROMs and PC-built .so cache modules.
game.developer: SEGA AM2 (Recomp: alphanu1, ARM64 Port: DaytonaArm)
